reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text:
Beware, possible scam! I requested cancellation several times and they always claim it’s canceled, yet they keep charging $45 every month. There is no way to cancel through the app or Apple. I even changed my credit card and the charges continue. Terrible experience. Total charging: 450 dollars. 

¡Cuidado, posible estafa! He solicitado cancelar la suscripción varias veces y siempre dicen que está cancelada, pero siguen cobrando $45 al mes. Ni desde la app ni desde Apple pude cancelarla. Es muy difícil llegar al Support Center. Incluso cambié de tarjeta de crédito y continúan los cobros. Muy mala experiencia. Me viene cobrando 450 dólares!!! No caigan en esto!!!
reviews.reply:
Hi [Name],

Thank you for sharing your feedback.

We’re sorry to hear about your experience and understand your concern about seeing charges after trying to cancel.

Nebula cannot process payments without user authorization, and subscriptions can only continue while they remain active.

If you were charged after requesting cancellation, we’d like to review your case carefully and check what happened with your subscription status and payments.

Please contact us at support-appstore@asknebula.com and share the payment details connected to these charges, so our team can investigate this properly and assist you further.

Guiding you toward clarity,
Nebula
